scope: s2e01 scene anchors s02 (A), s10 (B), s13 (C), s26 (D), s31 (E), attempt 1 each
method: Each 1440x2560 png viewed whole, then cropped at full resolution with ffmpeg: face crops set beside the sheet close-up (nandini.png front close-up; Tripathi and Pushpa faces from their pair sheets), plus crops of epaulettes, pen, pouch, hands, token, helmet, desk props, wall tokens, envelope tags and silhouettes. Sides judged from the pouch (her RIGHT hip) and pen (her LEFT pocket) in each frame.

s02.checked: identity matches sheet close-up; two bars each epaulette; pen picture-right; pouch picture-left; token string in picture-left fist (her right), token hanging; helmet under picture-right arm (her left) at hip; bench empty; blank tokens on nail; poster frames blank; face in top 30%
nits: Framed head to mid-shin, not head to mid-thigh; the push-in at focus y 0.3 tightens it.
Token drawn as an upright rectangle, the sheet's is near-square.

s10.checked: plate layout kept, light changed to day; pale-grey scooter at lowered gate, seen from behind-right; helmet worn, strap visible under the jaw; pouch on her right hip (picture-right from behind); token hanging from the right hand on the right grip; no train; no text
nits: Head turned forward-right, not down to her right hand.
Keeper shows hands plus a white sleeve and forearm at the left edge, not hands only.

s13.checked: Nandini identity and two bars; profile to picture-right, pouch on near hip, right (near) wrist with token looped and hanging; helmet far side at waist; pen peeks at the far pocket edge; Tripathi identity vs pair sheet (bald dome, grey fringe, jowls), three bars, vest V, half sleeves, gamchha picture-right, cone in picture-right hand (his left), other hand flat on desk; desk phone handset down with blank buttons, two closed files, shells; shield plate blank, front-on, about 18-24% down; no text
nits: Height not testable: he is seated.

s26.reason: Side error on the token. Nandini faces the camera (pouch picture-left, pen picture-right), so the token string looped on her picture-right wrist is on her LEFT wrist; STATE and continuity end_state require the RIGHT wrist. She sets the helmet down with her right (picture-left) hand, not the left the shot asks for. As the scene D anchor this would carry the wrong wrist into every later scene D frame (D-013 rule 2).
s26.checked_ok: Nandini and Pushpa identities match the pair sheet; Pushpa one bar, low steel spectacles, crossed needles, bag on picture-right (her left) shoulder, orange wool in picture-left (her right) pocket, hands empty; helmet resting on bench; blank tokens on nail; frames blank; faces about 30-35% down
s26.not_measured: Pair height: Nandini bends at the waist, so her standing height cannot be measured; it reads plausible by eye.

s31.checked: reverse view with window on right wall; identity matches sheet close-up (looking down); two bars; pouch picture-left, pen picture-right; right (picture-left) hand flat on top page with token string on wrist; left (picture-right) hand at the stack edge; red cloth untied under the pages, tape ends hanging; two flat featureless silhouettes in the stair doorway, level peaked cap and bun with crossed needles, bag on her picture-right; envelope tags blank; ruled page lines carry no lettering
nits: The file reads as a bound ruled book with a spine more than loose complaint papers in a cloth; it could be read as a register. Later scene E frames inherit this from the anchor.

style_frame_watch_D021: None of s02, s10, s26, s31 copies the thana fan, shield, almirah, clock, barred door or doorway shaft. 0 of 4.

The hand on the PICTURE-LEFT side (her right) sets the helmet on the bench, and the token's string is looped round that SAME picture-left wrist, the token dangling beside the helmet. Her picture-right hand (her left) hangs empty with a bare wrist. Update shots.json s26 framing/action ('left hand') to match. Keep everything else.
